structured.answer: Open an account at Psagot and buy the Yelin Lapidot S&P 500 tracker fund. The page calls that the cheapest pair: about 86,492 ₪ left after 10 years in its example, against roughly 68–71k at the big banks, so that's what I'd do first.

stuck.why: About 19 near-identical S&P 500 funds, each with lots of coloured tags I don't understand. Some had minuses (−533 ₪, −0.43%) and I couldn't pick one.
#1 is 'אינטראקטיב ישראל', a name I've never heard of, so I hesitated and looked for a name I know.
The defaults are 10,000 and 500/month, not my 30,000. I left them, so the numbers aren't my numbers.
